text: Now, you keep it under another time and you’ll make money by it. Shall I ring for them to carry you down?” “When are we to hear more of this?” Mrs. Chadband sternly demands. “Bless your heart for a true woman! Always curious, your delightful sex is!” replies Mr. Bucket with gallantry. “I shall have the pleasure of giving you a call to-morrow or next day—not forgetting Mr. Smallweed and his proposal of two fifty.” “Five hundred!” exclaims Mr. Smallweed.
